options.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a polished character-design selection sheet for a romantic layered-paper-cut Chinese music video, option A, titled exactly “A · 清透文艺”. This is NEW character concept artwork, not a film frame. Landscape wide sheet, clean warm ivory paper background, six large detailed head-and-shoulder portraits arranged in a precise 2-row by 3-column grid. Top row is the SAME attractive young East Asian woman, age 22–26, viewed straight-on, 30-degree three-quarter view, and true 90-degree right-facing profile. Bottom row is the SAME handsome young East Asian man, age 23–27, in those same three views. Column labels exactly “正面”, “四分之三侧面”, “纯侧面”. Keep complete hair and shoulders inside the page. Faces large enough to judge shape and expression, coherent identity across each row. Woman: graceful oval face, softly tapered chin, naturally sized expressive almond brown eyes with fine upper lash definition, both eyes clearly visible in front and 30-degree views, delicate understated nose and lips, calm warm small smile, medium-long dark chestnut hair to collarbone with soft side part and subtle inward curl, small gold stud earrings, ivory blouse, a small swatch of dusty-rose skirt color near the shoulder edge or row label. Man: elegant friendly face, balanced jaw, naturally proportioned lively brown eyes, softly layered short black hair with a loose fringe, muted navy jacket and ochre scarf. Medium: exquisitely designed 2D editorial illustration with softly layered cut-paper shapes, nuanced but economical facial planes, controlled subtle warm shading, tasteful paper grain and refined edges. This must look significantly more attractive and sophisticated than basic SVG geometric people, without becoming photorealistic. Maintain restrained teal/ivory/dusty rose/ochre palette compatible with a sophisticated paper-cut animation. Consistent face construction and head scale across all views. Avoid chibi, oversized eyes, doll face, triangle nose, circular head, crude polygon face, stick arms, thick dark outlines, flattened single-eye face in front or three-quarter view, blank expression, 3D plastic, mockup scenery. For actual profile only one eye is anatomically visible. No extra characters, no scenery, no explanatory paragraph, no watermark. Beautiful art-director quality face turnaround sheet, crisp fine features.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create a beautiful professional character turnaround selection sheet for the protagonists of a romantic Chinese music video, concept option B. Title exactly “B · 青春动画”. A NEW design direction, not photorealism. Wide landscape sheet with a warm ivory background and simple refined grid. Six LARGE bust portraits, 2 rows and 3 columns: same young adult East Asian woman across top row, same young adult East Asian man across bottom row. Columns are straight-on face, gentle 30-degree three-quarter face (both eyes visible), and true 90-degree profile facing right. Exact column captions “正面”, “四分之三侧面”, “纯侧面”. Beautiful modern 2D animated feature character art with precise clean fine linework, expressive but naturally proportioned almond eyes, subtle cel shading with no more than 3 tones per material, crisp layered hair masses and restrained paper-texture accents. Attractive design, believable adult proportions, tender sincere emotional look, romantic warmth, not childlike. Woman age 23: elegant soft oval face, slightly tapered chin, dark chocolate long hair falling just below shoulders, loose airy curtain bangs revealing the forehead and eyes, clear warm brown eyes, small delicate nose with curved natural profile, graceful softly smiling lips, ivory round-neck blouse, dusty rose garment accent. Man age 25: warm friendly handsome face, naturally shaped jaw, dark side-part hair with slightly swept airy fringe, relaxed brown eyes and gentle confident smile, navy jacket and warm ochre scarf. Keep exact identity, hair shape, eye color, facial structure, clothing and age consistent across the three views of each character. Delicate feminine face contrasted with a slightly more angular masculine face. Heads similar size, complete hairstyles and shoulders visible, generous clean gutters. Colors muted and sophisticated, adapted for a teal-and-gold layered paper-cut music video. Avoid generic flat geometric SVG avatars, dots for eyes, long triangular pointed noses, huge anime eyes, chibi, schoolchildren, heavy makeup, plastic 3D, glossy render, exaggerated jaw, infant face, photo collage, busy scenery, incorrect extra facial features, lost far eye in three-quarter view. Show a single anatomically correct eye in true profile only. No scenery, no logos, no watermark, no extra characters, no prose.

Use case: stylized-concept. Produce one NEW professional illustrated character turnaround concept sheet, labeled exactly “C · 精致剪纸”. This option MUST be visually DISTINCT from realistic watercolor portraiture: it is actual layered cut-paper character design, with clean sculpted paper shapes, restrained shallow cast shadows and 3–5 large tonal planes per face. A sophisticated romantic animated-paper-film look. Wide landscape ivory paper presentation sheet, EXACTLY 2 rows by 3 columns. Top row: the same attractive East Asian young woman aged 23 in FRONT, 30-DEGREE THREE-QUARTER and TRUE 90-DEGREE RIGHT PROFILE. Bottom row: same handsome East Asian young man aged 25 in corresponding views. Exact column headings “正面”, “四分之三侧面”, “纯侧面”. Close head-and-shoulder framing; face and eyes LARGE, complete hairstyle visible, same scale all six cells. WOMAN: elegant oval face, graceful cheek curve and soft jaw, natural medium-size almond dark-brown eyes with finely cut tapered eyelids and small warm highlight, both eyes visible in front and three-quarter; natural curved small nose, slightly full softly smiling rosy lips. Beautiful silky dark chestnut chin-to-shoulder bob with side-swept curtain fringe, hair built from 6–9 curved overlapping paper locks, NOT a crude cap, no fine hair strands. Pearl-ivory blouse and dusty-rose accent; tiny gold earrings. MAN: soft handsome mature face and well-balanced jaw, kind eyes, gently swept dark hair built from curved paper locks, NOT triangles or spikes, navy jacket and ochre scarf. Anatomical profile only has one visible eye but is graceful and naturally constructed, not a protruding triangular nose. Rounded facial shapes cut from warm cream, blush and tan paper; skin subtle dimensional layering, refined brows and lips, expressive gentle gaze. Clothing from visibly stacked tactile matte paper with small edge shadows. Pale warm ivory background. Beautiful editorial storytelling sophistication. More designed and attractive than generic vector avatars; do not copy their simplified dot eyes, polygon nose, or rigid face. NO photorealism, watercolor, graphite drawing, continuous ink outlines, glossy plastic 3D, chibi, oversized anime eyes, childish heads, geometric robot faces, eyelashes like doll fans, thick outlines, spiky hair, too many skin layers making a contour-map face, scene backgrounds or extra people. Maintain excellent consistent identity between all views in each row. No watermarks or explanatory paragraphs.
